scope: Descriptive passive-accounting study of four new original sharedGUI saved-source windows; no intervention orzero-observer effect estimate.
limits: CPU account intervals include observer and all process concurrency; do not assign entire processCPU to the model.
Caller-threadCPU excludes native worker CPU; wall minus callerCPU is not GIL waiting.
Cycles are not actualGHz and threadCPU granularity is not per-call precision.
Operational state labels are exploratory proxies, not old stack/perturbation gates orroot causes.
Every attempted/failed/unattempted case retained, no replacement oroptional extension.
